title: Line dances for Seniors and Beginners - Electric Slide, Cupid Shuffle, and more!

extraction.teacher_style: Jenny uses a friendly, encouraging tone and breaks down line dances step-by-step for beginners. She demonstrates movements from the back so viewers can mirror her easily.

lesson_structure.note: Jenny introduces the lineup of line dances.
Breaks down the steps of the Cupid Shuffle.
Breaks down the steps of the Electric Slide.

steps_taught.name: Cupid Shuffle steps
steps_taught.description: Four steps to the right and four steps to the left.

steps_taught.name: Cupid Shuffle kicks
steps_taught.description: Four kicks with a twist and turn.

what_works: Clear step-by-step breakdown without music first
Facing away from the camera allows easy mirroring

quotes.text: It's step-by-step and then it's to music.
So let's put it together, no music.
Get ready, it's a little faster, not much.
We got about four moves in this.
